content.description: Introducing the DHP Nia Upholstered Modern, Adjustable Sofa Bed and Couch in Camel Faux Leather - the perfect blend of mid-century style and modern functionality. This stylish futon is a versatile addition to any small living space, offering both comfort and style. Upholstered in eye-catching faux leather, the Nia features a tufted back and tapered wooden legs for a chic look. The split back design allows for three different positions of comfort, making it ideal for lounging or accommodating overnight guests at a moment's notice. With a sturdy wood construction and wide track arms, the Nia provides extra comfort and support for up to 600lbs. This multi-functional piece ships in one box and assembles quickly and easily, making setup a breeze. Available in Camel Faux Leather, Blue Velvet, or Grey Velvet, the Nia can be paired with the matching Nia modern chair for a complete look in your home. Sofa dimensions: 78.5"L x 34"W x 32.5"H Sleeping Dimensions: 78.5"L x 43.5"W x 24"H Carton dimensions: 45.5"L x 36"W x 17.5"H Weight Limit: 600 lbs Don't compromise on style or comfort - bring home the DHP Nia Upholstered Modern, Adjustable Sofa Bed and Couch today. Futon sofa bed leather at its finest.
